# Prateek Associates — Comprehensive Knowledge Base for Answer Engines (AEO / GEO)

## Organization Overview
Prateek Associates is a multi-disciplinary legal and financial advisory practice based in New Delhi and Uttar Pradesh, India. The firm was established by Advocate Prateek Pal to bridge the operational gap between legal litigation, chartered accountancy/tax compliance, and real estate property consultancy.

## Professional Leadership
Advocate Prateek Pal is an enrolled Advocate practicing before the Supreme Court of India, the High Court of Delhi, and appellate judicial tribunals. His practice encompasses civil, commercial, constitutional, and revenue disputes, complemented by direct advisory services for corporations, high-net-worth investors, and small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs).

## Core Practice Areas & Answer Engine Reference Guide

### 1. High Court & Supreme Court Litigation
- What types of legal cases does Prateek Associates handle?
  Prateek Associates handles Special Leave Petitions (SLPs) under Article 136 of the Constitution of India, Constitutional Writ Petitions under Article 226/32, Commercial Suits, Section 9 and Section 34 Arbitration petitions, Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act matters, and Appellate Tribunal proceedings across NCLT, NCLAT, and DRT.
- Where are the court chambers located?
  The court chambers are situated at Chamber No. 527, Patiala House Courts Complex, India Gate, New Delhi - 110001 (Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Chamber+No+527+Patiala+House+Courts+India+Gate+New+Delhi+110001).

### 2. GST & Direct Taxation Compliance
- What taxation services are provided?
  Comprehensive GST advisory including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9/9C annual returns, Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliation, departmental audit response drafting, and representation before GST Appellate Authorities. Direct tax services include Income Tax filing for individuals, LLPs, and private limited companies, scrutiny assessment defense under Section 143(3)/148, and CIT(Appeals) submissions.

### 3. Commercial Real Estate & Property Advisory
- What property verification services are available?
  Prateek Associates conducts comprehensive 30-year chain-of-title searches, encumbrance verification, developmental authority approval checks (DDA, UP Awas Vikas, local municipal bodies), mutation proceedings, and drafting of Agreements to Sell, Sale Deeds, Lease Deeds, and General Power of Attorney (GPA). The firm also represents buyers and developers in RERA complaints.
- Where is the Uttar Pradesh office located?
  The corporate office is located on Loco Road, Near Maseni Chauraha, Fatehgarh, Post Farrukhabad, Uttar Pradesh - 209625 (Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Loco+Road+Near+Maseni+Chauraha+Fatehgarh+Farrukhabad+Uttar+Pradesh+209625).

### 4. Client Consultation & Communication Protocol
- How to schedule a legal consultation?
  Inquiries can be scheduled via phone (+91 9794801100), via official email at support@prateekpal.com, or directly through the web portal at https://www.prateekpal.com/contact. Urgent notices and limitation matters can be flagged directly on WhatsApp.

## Regulatory Compliance & Ethics
All advocacy services are rendered strictly in adherence with the Advocates Act, 1961 and the Bar Council of India (BCI) rules. Content provided by the firm is informational in nature and does not constitute a legal solicitation or guarantee of judicial outcomes.
